highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 previews the Skia M154 renderer and ships compiler XML documentation with the packages.
highlights_body: The release also updates HarfBuzzSharp generation and disables RAW and DNG image decoding. Review the HarfBuzz compatibility changes before upgrading.

breaking.title: HarfBuzz combining-class enum name corrected
breaking.body: UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 was renamed to CCC132 to match upstream HarfBuzz; update source code that referenced the misspelled member.

breaking.title: GlyphFlags.Defined is no longer available
breaking.body: The aggregate Defined mask is no longer exposed. Combine the concrete glyph flags required by your application instead.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer with the M154 engine and its subsequent upstream fixes, including GPU buffer-upload and failed-flush cache corrections.
Managed packages now carry compiler-generated XML documentation sidecars, improving API documentation in IDEs and package consumers.
Prevents the bundled decoder from accepting RAW and DNG images in this release line.

contributor_summaries.azchohfi: Improved the HarfBuzz native build warning suppression

preview_summaries.v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9: Preview 1 opened the 4.154 line with the Skia M154 renderer.
preview_summaries.v4.154.0-preview.2.26471.11: Preview 2 adds upstream rendering fixes, package XML documentation, and regenerated HarfBuzzSharp bindings.
preview_summaries.v4.154.0-rc.1.26479.14: Release Candidate 1 finalizes the preview line and disables RAW and DNG image decoding.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp now generates bindings from the HarfBuzz source pinned by Skia and updates the bundled library to 14.2.1. The corrected combining-class enum name and removed aggregate glyph-flag mask require the source changes described above.

v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9.headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 Preview 1 introduces the Skia M154 engine line.

v4.154.0-preview.2.26471.11.headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 Preview 2 updates the rendering engine and package documentation.
v4.154.0-preview.2.26471.11.body: It includes upstream M154 fixes and refreshed HarfBuzzSharp bindings.

v4.154.0-rc.1.26479.14.headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 Release Candidate 1 prepares the M154 line for release.
v4.154.0-rc.1.26479.14.body: RAW and DNG image decoding are disabled in this release candidate.
